physicalNotes: Radius 0.10812758 Jupiter radii from Lillo-Box et al. 2020 (2020A&A...640A..48L), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020A&A...640A..48L/abstract): 7,730.3 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. GM from the mass 0.00660734 Jupiter masses (Lillo-Box et al. 2020, the mass the NASA Exoplanet Archive's composite table adopts (2020A&A...640A..48L), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive, https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020A&A...640A..48L/abstract) times JPL's Jupiter GM. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
